get_account.title: Get the account behind the API key
get_account.description: Return the name recorded for the API key this connection uses. The cheapest way to confirm the credential still works and to show which Hullo account an agent is about to message from.

output.description: The account the API key belongs to.

name.description: The name given to the API key in the Hullo application.

list_attributes.title: List the account's attributes
list_attributes.description: List the attribute definitions configured on the account -- the only names `upsert_member` may set. Each carries its type, its edit type and, for list attributes, the exact `listItems` a member value must come from. Call this before writing member attributes rather than guessing names.

output.description: Every attribute an account member record may carry.

listItems.description: Allowed values, when the attribute is a list.

send_message.title: Send a message to a member
send_message.description: Send an SMS to one opted-in member. The member must have confirmed their opt-in or the call is rejected -- this does not create members. Messages over 160 GSM characters are split into 140-character parts and billed per part; any character outside GSM 03.38 switches the whole message to unicode and shortens those limits further.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number in international form without a leading + or 0, e.g. "447700912345".

issue_date.description: When to issue the message, ISO 8601. Must be at least two minutes in the future; omit to send now.

output.description: The submitted message, with the id Hullo assigned it.

list_messages.title: List a member's messages
list_messages.description: The messages sent to and received from one member, newest first. Inbound replies are flagged `inbound: true`, which is how to read a conversation rather than only what was sent.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number in international form without a leading + or 0.

inbound.description: True when the member sent it.

upsert_member.title: Add or update a member
upsert_member.description: Create a member or update the record of an existing one. A number Hullo has not seen is sent an opt-in text and only becomes messageable once the person replies "yes" -- so this does not, on its own, make a number reachable by `send_message`. Attribute names must already exist on the account (see `list_attributes`) and every value is an array of strings.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number in international form without a leading + or 0.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by attribute name, each an array of strings, e.g. {"Location": ["London"]}.

groups.description: Group names this member belongs to.

output.description: The member record as Hullo now stores it.

get_member.title: Get a member
get_member.description: The record Hullo holds for one member -- name, registration date, groups and every attribute value set through the API or the application.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number in international form without a leading + or 0.

opt_out_member.title: Opt a member out
opt_out_member.description: Opt the member out of the member store. This deletes their record and any pending messages queued for them, and drops them out of every campaign. It cannot be undone from the API -- the person has to opt in again.

phone_number.description: The member's phone number in international form without a leading + or 0.

output.description: Empty on success; the member and their pending messages are gone.
